description: Everything the adapter sends while migrate() runs, in order, captured from the real adapter (adapter construction included). `fresh` is an empty database; `current` one where every migration ran already. applied_at is the clock at migrate() time (fixed here).

fresh.note: the libSQL client opens it with BEGIN IMMEDIATE

fresh.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS iam_schema_version (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), version INTEGER NOT NULL)
SELECT version FROM iam_schema_version WHERE id = 1
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS iam_migrations (name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, applied_at BIGINT NOT NULL)
SELECT name FROM iam_migrations

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS iam_records (collection TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, unique_key TEXT, data TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (collection, id), UNIQUE (collection, tenant_id, unique_key))

INSERT INTO iam_migrations (name, applied_at) VALUES (?, ?)
